title: Om Sai Ram
desc: Three brothers, Om, Sai and Ram, get separated in their childhood due to unfortunate circumstances. However, years later they are reunited by fate.

title: Bhikshuka 2
desc: After being falsely accused, an ex-convict, looking of his sister, finds himself in trouble when his brain is transplanted into a wealthy man's body.

title: Jessie
desc: Nandini, a young doctor, falls in love with Jessie, a happy-go-lucky man. But when Nandini gets married to Shyam Prasad at her parents' insistence, Jessie comes back in her life as a ghost.
